title: Little Creature Crawl
hook: Larva or nymph? The life-cycle path tells us.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: two small beats of thinking space
visualStyle: soft 3D tiny-creature storybook, mossy garden palette, friendly magnified forms, high-contrast clean silhouettes

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child following life stages across different insect groups
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written stage-aware lines; adult mapped object does not imply its juvenile looks same
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: stage cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe transform gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a soft pizzicato tiptoe figure with a dew-drop bell ping.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a soft pizzicato tiptoe figure with a dew-drop bell ping
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Little Creature Crawl a life-cycle song: egg/larva/pupa/adult concepts are contrasted with incomplete-metamorphosis nymphs, using the mapped caterpillar-like Inchworm and many adult insects to show that young stages can look very different.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child tracks 'same animal, different stage' rather than a morning wake-up parade.
